restaurant.name: Lotus Lane Kitchen
restaurant.tagline: Vietnamese street food, made fresh every day
restaurant.description: A neighborhood Vietnamese kitchen. Slow-simmered phở, crispy bánh mì and fresh herbs in every bowl.
